scope: DART distribution evaluator (registry dart -> flowmdm_babel); separate file because config/evalkit_v1_20261107.json is frozen. Registered before any generated row is scored.

evaluator.checkpoint: outputs/assets/dart-official/flowmdm/text_mot_match_babel_random_motion_bs64/model/finest.tar (receipt sha256 of the zip in that directory)
evaluator.code: DART repository vendored FlowMDM (baselines/DART/FlowMDM, DART commit bb67ae1ed6ce051080468bf15bc6e54a6c3f8417); babel_flowmdm.py identical to upstream FlowMDM e81c67fa
evaluator.networks: TextEncoderBiGRUCo(300, POS, 512, 512), MovementConvEncoder(135, 512, 512), MotionEncoderBiGRUCo(512, 1024, 512); unit length 4; whole segments padded to 200 frames (BABEL_SingleEval, no crop)
evaluator.features: Globalvelandy rot6d, canonicalize + offset, babel-amass rfeats_mean/std: root translation z, canonical root xy velocity, 22 SMPL rotations; 30 fps
evaluator.glove: outputs/assets/motionlcm/glove (our_vab, the HumanML3D evaluator vocabulary FlowMDM downloads)

ground_truth.rule: BABEL_SingleEval load_mode gt: sequences with frame annotations; each segment start=int(start_t*fps), end=min(T, int(end_t*fps)); fix_spell(proc_label); transitions excluded; 15 <= end-start <= 200 (eval.py SEQ_LENS babel); standarize_text

text.tokens: upstream process_text uses spaCy en_core_web_sm (not installed: the model download failed with a connection reset). Fallback: each word gets its most frequent token in the HumanML3D test captions (tag_from_ground_truth); words never seen there get word/OTHER (glove vector if known, else unk). Coverage is reported. Deviation from upstream.
text.r_precision: batches of 32 from seeded permutations, 20 repeats (same rule as the t2m amendment)

input_path.problem: all generated rows (DART included) are SMPL-22 joint positions only; the evaluator needs SMPL rotations
input_path.ik: SMPL-H male (AMASS smplh_amass/male/model.npz, sha256 be42bff1...) rest bone directions, per-sequence bone lengths (median over frames); joint-only forward kinematics; translation = pelvis - zero-beta rest root; Adam on 6d rotations, 500 iterations, lr 0.02, loss = joint error cm^2 + 1e-3 ||R - I||^2 + 1e-2 ||R_t - R_t-1||^2 (约定，未经推演)
input_path.pre_registration_trial: 300 ground-truth segments (seed flowmdm_ik_trial): SMPL-X zero-beta fixed skeleton gave 21.6 mm mean joint residual (BABEL neck/collars 4.8-5.2 cm longer, head 6.1 cm shorter); the per-sequence SMPL-H skeleton gives 1.5 mm (p99 7.8 mm) but the features still drift (mean |z| 0.98; embedding L2 6.4 vs mean norm 10.6), concentrated in knee/ankle/shoulder/elbow rotations: twist about the bone and the rotations of joints without a child among the 22 are not observable from joint positions
input_path.reference: primary: ground-truth joints through the same IK (ik reference), so generated rows and reference carry the same information; the native-rotation reference (official) is reported descriptively, not used for scoring
input_path.resampling: linear to 30 fps when the row fps differs

self_checks.split_half: FID between random halves of the ik reference, 5 seeds
self_checks.round_trip: ik reference half A -> fitted joints -> IK -> features; pass if FID(round trip, original) < min split-half FID (rule of the main protocol, 约定，未经推演)
self_checks.native_vs_ik: descriptive: FID(native half A, ik half A), FID(native half A, ik half B), text match on native features
self_checks.perturbation_monotone: joint noise 0.01/0.02/0.05/0.10 m and frame shuffle 0.05/0.2/0.5 on half A joints, then IK; FID vs ik half B strictly increasing
self_checks.text_match: matched top-3 > 3 x shuffled top-3 on the ik reference
self_checks.n_bias: as the main protocol (N 8..1024, 20 repeats, min-N rule 约定，未经推演)

smoke_c0.rows: the 5 DART rows of the 8x5 manifest (native goal change, 600 frames, 30 fps, no text prompt)
smoke_c0.windows: non-overlapping 200-frame windows from frame 0, last window kept if >= 15 frames (约定，未经推演); 3 per row
smoke_c0.metrics: FID of the 15 windows vs the full ik reference (N far below min N: not a quality estimate), diversity, IK residual per row; no text metrics (rows have no prompt)
